tasks.title: Setup Git Ignore
tasks.prompt: Create the `.gitignore` file. Ensure it includes standard Node.js, Next.js (`.next`, `.env.*`), and OS-specific ignore patterns. Explicitly ignore `.env.local`, `.env.production`, and `node_modules`.

tasks.title: Configure ESLint
tasks.prompt: Create or modify the `.eslintrc.json` file. Configure it to extend `eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals` and relevant TypeScript/React plugins. Enforce project coding standards.

tasks.title: Configure ESLint Ignore
tasks.prompt: Create the `.eslintignore` file. List files and directories that should be ignored by ESLint, such as build outputs (`.next`), configuration files (`next.config.mjs`), and potentially generated files.

tasks.title: Configure Prettier
tasks.prompt: Create the `.prettierrc.json` file. Define project formatting rules (e.g., `semi: true`, `singleQuote: false`, `tabWidth: 2`, `printWidth: 80`, `trailingComma: 'es5'`).

tasks.title: Configure Prettier Ignore
tasks.prompt: Create the `.prettierignore` file. List files and directories to be ignored by Prettier, typically including build outputs, `package-lock.json`, and potentially large data files.

tasks.title: Configure Tailwind CSS
tasks.prompt: Modify `tailwind.config.ts`. Ensure `content` includes paths to `app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}` and `components/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}`. Configure theme extensions or plugins if needed. Integrate Shadcn/ui theme settings.

tasks.title: Configure PostCSS
tasks.prompt: Modify `postcss.config.js`. Ensure it includes `tailwindcss` and `autoprefixer` plugins as required for Next.js and Tailwind CSS integration.

tasks.title: Setup Global CSS
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/globals.css`. Include Tailwind CSS directives (`@tailwind base;`, `@tailwind components;`, `@tailwind utilities;`). Add any base global styles or CSS variable definitions required by Shadcn/ui or the project.

tasks.title: Verify Shadcn/ui Config
tasks.prompt: Verify or create `components.json`. Ensure the configuration aligns with the project structure for UI components (`components/ui`), utilities (`lib/utils.ts`), and styling choices (CSS Variables).

tasks.title: Verify Shadcn/ui Utils
tasks.prompt: Verify or create `lib/utils.ts`. Ensure the `cn` utility function for merging Tailwind classes is present as generated by `shadcn-ui init`. Add any other general-purpose utility functions needed early on.

tasks.title: Create Environment Example
tasks.prompt: Create the `.env.example` file. List all required environment variables (e.g., `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) with placeholder values, documenting their purpose.

tasks.title: Initialize README
tasks.prompt: Create the initial `README.md`. Include the project title (Skaldur), a brief overview, and sections for Setup/Installation and Running the Development Server.

tasks.title: Create Setup Guide
tasks.prompt: Create `docs/SETUP_GUIDE.md`. Provide detailed steps for developers to set up the project locally, including cloning, installing dependencies, setting up environment variables (`.env.local`), and running the dev server.

tasks.title: Initialize Architecture Doc
tasks.prompt: Create `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Add placeholders for key sections based on the blueprint: Overview, System Architecture, Technology Stack, Data Models, API Design, etc. These will be filled later.

tasks.title: Initialize API Guide
tasks.prompt: Create `docs/API_GUIDE.md`. Add placeholders for documenting each API endpoint (`/api/config/improvement-options`, `/api/improve`, `/api/name-session`), including method, purpose, request/response schemas.

tasks.title: Setup Basic CI Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create the initial `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Configure a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on push/pull_request. Include steps to checkout code, setup Node.js, install dependencies (`npm ci`), and run linters (`npm run lint`).

tasks.title: Create Types Index
tasks.prompt: Create `types/index.ts`. Set it up to re-export types from other files within the `types` directory for easier imports elsewhere in the application.

tasks.title: Define Utility Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/utility.ts`. Define any common reusable TypeScript utility types needed across the project (e.g., `Optional<T, K>`, `Require<T, K>`).

tasks.title: Define Session Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/session.ts`. Define TypeScript interfaces: `Message`, `InteractionLLMSettings`, `DestinationLLMSettings`, `LockedSettings`, `SessionDetails`, `SessionMetadata`. Export these types.

tasks.title: Define Config Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/config.ts`. Define TypeScript interfaces: `ImprovementType` (including backend-only fields), `LLMOption`, `LLMOptionGroup`, `ImprovementOptionsResponse`. Export these types.

tasks.title: Define API Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/api.ts`. Define TypeScript interfaces for API request and response payloads: `ImprovePromptRequest`, `ImprovePromptResponse`, `NameSessionRequest`, `NameSessionResponse`. Export these types.

tasks.title: Define Environment Types
tasks.prompt: Create `types/environment.d.ts`. Declare types for environment variables accessed via `process.env` to ensure type safety, aligning with variables defined in `.env.example`.

tasks.title: Define Default Constants
tasks.prompt: Create `constants/defaults.ts`. Define and export default constant values, such as `DEFAULT_TEMPERATURE`, `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS`, and initial session names/placeholders.

tasks.title: Define LLM Provider Constants
tasks.prompt: Create `constants/llm-providers.ts`. Define and export constants or enums representing supported LLM provider identifiers (e.g., 'OpenAI', 'Anthropic') for consistent use.

tasks.title: Define Storage Key Constants
tasks.prompt: Create `constants/storage-keys.ts`. Define and export constants for keys used in Local Storage, primarily the key for the persisted Zustand store (e.g., `SKALDUR_SESSION_STORE_KEY`).

tasks.title: Create Improvement Options Config
tasks.prompt: Create `config/improvement-options.json`. Define the structure containing an array of `ImprovementType` objects (including `id`, `name`, `icon`, `description`, `systemPrompt`, `template`) and an array of `styles` (strings).

tasks.title: Create LLM Options Config
tasks.prompt: Create `config/llm-options.json`. Define the structure containing arrays for `interactionLlmOptions` and `destinationLlmOptions`, following the `LLMOptionGroup` interface (provider name and list of models with id/name).

tasks.title: Create Validation Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/validation.ts`. Implement input validation logic, potentially using Zod schemas, for API request bodies (`ImprovePromptRequest`, `NameSessionRequest`). Export validation functions or schemas.

tasks.title: Create Server-Side LLM Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/llm-utils.server.ts`. Implement functions to securely call external LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) using API keys from `process.env`. Handle request formatting and basic error mapping. Mark as server-only.

tasks.title: Create API Route: Get Config Options
tasks.prompt: Create the API route `app/api/config/improvement-options/route.ts`. Implement the `GET` handler to read data from `config/improvement-options.json` and `config/llm-options.json`. Format and return the response according to `ImprovementOptionsResponse` type.

tasks.title: Create API Route: Improve Prompt (Initial)
tasks.prompt: Create the API route `app/api/improve/route.ts`. Implement the basic structure for the `POST` handler. Include imports, define the function signature, and add placeholder logic for request handling.

tasks.title: Implement Improve Prompt Validation & Locking
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/api/improve/route.ts`. Implement request body validation using `lib/validation.ts`. Add logic to handle the first request for a session: extract and potentially store/lock `interactionLLM` and `destinationLLM` settings (mechanism TBD - likely client-driven locking).

tasks.title: Implement Improve Prompt LLM Logic
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/api/improve/route.ts`. Implement the core LLM interaction. Retrieve locked session settings. Load the correct `ImprovementType` config. Construct the meta-prompt using system prompt, template, user input, style, and destination context. Call the Interaction LLM via `llm-utils.server.ts`. Return `ImprovePromptResponse`.

tasks.title: Create API Route: Name Session (Initial)
tasks.prompt: Create the API route `app/api/name-session/route.ts`. Implement the basic structure for the `POST` handler. Include imports, define the function signature, and add placeholder logic.

tasks.title: Implement Name Session Logic
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/api/name-session/route.ts`. Implement request validation. Retrieve the session's Interaction LLM settings. Construct a prompt asking the LLM to generate a concise name based on initial prompt/response. Call the LLM via `llm-utils.server.ts`. Return `NameSessionResponse`.

tasks.title: Create Zustand UI Slice
tasks.prompt: Create `store/ui-slice.ts`. Define state for UI elements like sidebar visibility (`isSessionSidebarOpen`, `isConfigSidebarOpen`), current error (`currentError`), and global loading flags. Include corresponding actions (e.g., `toggleSessionSidebar`, `setError`, `clearError`).

tasks.title: Create Zustand Config Slice
tasks.prompt: Create `store/config-slice.ts`. Define state to hold fetched configuration data: `availableImprovementTypes`, `availableImprovementStyles`, `availableInteractionLlmOptions`, `availableDestinationLlmOptions`, and loading/error states for the fetch. Include an action `setConfigOptions`.

tasks.title: Create Zustand Session Slice (Initial)
tasks.prompt: Create `store/session-slice.ts`. Define the initial state structure: `sessions` (map of `SessionMetadata`), `sessionDetails` (map of `SessionDetails`), `activeSessionUUID`. Define basic actions: `setActiveSessionUUID`, `addSessionMetadata`, `updateSessionMetadata`, `addSessionDetails`.

tasks.title: Implement Session Slice Persistence
tasks.prompt: Modify `store/session-slice.ts`. Wrap the slice definition with the `persist` middleware from `zustand/middleware`. Configure it to persist `sessions`, `sessionDetails`, and `activeSessionUUID` to Local Storage using the key from `constants/storage-keys.ts`.

tasks.title: Create Zustand Store Index
tasks.prompt: Create `store/index.ts`. Import slice creators (`ui-slice`, `config-slice`, `session-slice`). Combine them into a single Zustand store using the slice pattern (`create((...a) => ({ ...createUiSlice(...a), ... }))`). Export the main `useStore` hook.

tasks.title: Setup Root Layout
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/layout.tsx`. Ensure it sets up the basic HTML structure (`<html>`, `<body>`). Apply global fonts if defined in `styles/fonts.css`. Render children. Add any necessary global context providers.

tasks.title: Create Main App Layout
tasks.prompt: Create `app/(main)/layout.tsx`. This layout applies to the main application view. Import and render structural components like `SessionSidebar`, `ConfigSidebar`, and the main content area (`{children}`). Manage sidebar visibility state if needed (potentially using `AppLayoutClient`).

tasks.title: Create Main App Page (Initial)
tasks.prompt: Create `app/(main)/page.tsx`. This is the main page component. Set it up as a client component (`'use client'`). Render the core feature components like `HistoryDisplay` and `PromptInputArea`. Include placeholder logic for fetching initial data.

tasks.title: Define Custom Fonts
tasks.prompt: Create `styles/fonts.css` (if custom fonts are used). Define `@font-face` rules or import fonts according to project design requirements. Ensure this file is imported in `app/layout.tsx`.

tasks.title: Create Session Sidebar Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/layout/SessionSidebar.tsx`. Implement the left sidebar UI using Shadcn `Sheet`. Display a list of sessions (using `SessionListItem`) fetched from Zustand state. Include a '+' button to trigger new session creation via store action.

tasks.title: Create Config Sidebar Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/layout/ConfigSidebar.tsx`. Implement the right sidebar UI using Shadcn `Sheet`. Conditionally render `LlmConfiguration` inputs (if session unlocked) or read-only display of locked settings. Include the 'Fork Session' button (conditionally).

tasks.title: Create App Layout Client Wrapper
tasks.prompt: Create `components/layout/AppLayoutClient.tsx` (if needed). Use this client component to wrap the main layout structure in `app/(main)/layout.tsx` if client-side state (like sidebar open/close) needs to be managed at this level.

tasks.title: Create Session List Item Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/SessionListItem.tsx`. Implement a component to display a single session's name (or timestamp) in the list. Handle click events to call the `setActiveSessionUUID` action from the store.

tasks.title: Create Chat Message Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/ChatMessage.tsx`. Implement a component to render a single message bubble. Style differently based on the `role` prop ('user' or 'assistant'). Display message content.

tasks.title: Create History Display Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/HistoryDisplay.tsx`. Implement a component using Shadcn `ScrollArea`. Fetch the active session's message history from Zustand state. Map over messages and render `ChatMessage` for each. Ensure it scrolls down automatically.

tasks.title: Create LLM Configuration Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/LlmConfiguration.tsx`. Implement a reusable component with inputs/selects (using Shadcn components) for LLM Provider, Model, Temperature, Max Tokens. Manage local state and trigger parent updates.

tasks.title: Create Improvement Selectors Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/ImprovementSelectors.tsx`. Implement dropdowns (Shadcn `Select` or `DropdownMenu`) for selecting Improvement Type and Style. Populate options from Zustand config state. Manage local selection state.

tasks.title: Create Prompt Input Area Component
tasks.prompt: Create `components/feature/PromptInputArea.tsx`. Implement the main input area using Shadcn `Textarea`. Include `ImprovementSelectors`. Add a Submit button. Manage textarea state. Handle submit action to trigger API call.

tasks.title: Create Sidebar Toggle Hook
tasks.prompt: Create `hooks/use-sidebar-toggle.ts`. Implement a custom hook to manage the open/close state of sidebars, interacting with actions and state defined in `store/ui-slice.ts`.

tasks.title: Create Session Manager Hook
tasks.prompt: Create `hooks/use-session-manager.ts`. Implement a hook acting as a facade for session state management. Expose functions for creating, selecting, forking, updating sessions by interacting with actions/state in `store/session-slice.ts`.

tasks.title: Create Local Storage Hook (Optional)
tasks.prompt: Create `hooks/use-local-storage.ts` (if needed). Implement a generic hook for interacting directly with Local Storage, potentially handling serialization/deserialization, if required beyond Zustand's persistence.

tasks.title: Create API Client Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/api-client.ts`. Implement typed wrapper functions (`fetchImprovementOptions`, `improvePrompt`, `nameSession`) using `fetch` to call backend API routes. Handle JSON parsing and basic error mapping. Use types from `types/api.ts`.

tasks.title: Integrate State in Session Sidebar
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/layout/SessionSidebar.tsx`. Use the `useStore` hook to select session list metadata. Use `useSessionManager` hook to handle session selection (`setActiveSessionUUID`) and creation (`createNewSession`).

tasks.title: Integrate State in Config Sidebar
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/layout/ConfigSidebar.tsx`. Use `useStore` to get active session's locked status and settings. Conditionally render `LlmConfiguration` or display data. Use `useSessionManager` to handle the 'Fork Session' action.

tasks.title: Integrate State in History Display
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/feature/HistoryDisplay.tsx`. Use `useStore` to select the active session's `messages` array from `sessionDetails`. Pass message data to `ChatMessage` components.

tasks.title: Integrate State in Prompt Input Area
tasks.prompt: Modify `components/feature/PromptInputArea.tsx`. Use `useStore` to get active session details (needed for submit context). Populate `ImprovementSelectors` from config state. On submit, call `improvePrompt` from `lib/api-client.ts` and update store via `useSessionManager`.

tasks.title: Implement Initial Data Fetching
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/(main)/page.tsx` or a layout client component. Use `useEffect` and `api-client.ts` to fetch initial configuration (`fetchImprovementOptions`) on mount. Dispatch action from `config-slice` to store the data.

tasks.title: Implement Core Workflow Orchestration
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/(main)/page.tsx`. Orchestrate the main interaction flow. Ensure components receive necessary props/context derived from active session state. Handle loading states during API calls.

tasks.title: Implement Session Locking Logic
tasks.prompt: Modify `store/session-slice.ts` and relevant components/hooks. Add logic to update the `lockedSettings` field within the active session's details after the first successful `/api/improve` call for that session.

tasks.title: Implement Auto Session Naming Trigger
tasks.prompt: Modify `app/(main)/page.tsx` or where the `improvePrompt` response is handled. After the *first* successful improvement for a session, trigger the `nameSession` API call using `api-client.ts`. Update session metadata via `session-slice` action on success.

tasks.title: Implement Error Modal State Handling
tasks.prompt: Modify `store/ui-slice.ts`. Ensure the `setError` and `clearError` actions correctly update the `currentError` state. Modify API call handlers (`api-client.ts` or components) to dispatch `setError` on failure.

tasks.title: Configure Vitest
tasks.prompt: Create `vitest.config.ts`. Configure Vitest for the Next.js project. Set up environment (e.g., 'jsdom'), include React plugin (`@vitejs/plugin-react`), define test file patterns, and reference setup files (`tests/setup/vitest.setup.ts`).

tasks.title: Configure Playwright
tasks.prompt: Create `playwright.config.ts`. Configure Playwright for E2E testing. Define browsers, base URL (using `process.env.PORT` or default), test directory (`tests/e2e`), and potentially web server command (`npm run dev`).

tasks.title: Create Vitest Setup File
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/setup/vitest.setup.ts`. Include necessary global setup for Vitest tests, such as importing `@testing-library/jest-dom/extend-expect`, configuring MSW (`msw-server.ts`), or setting up global mocks.

tasks.title: Create MSW Server Setup
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/setup/msw-server.ts`. Set up Mock Service Worker (MSW) using `setupServer`. Define request handlers to mock backend API endpoints (`/api/*`) for use in unit and integration tests.

tasks.title: Write Unit Test: Session Slice
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/store/session-slice.spec.ts`. Write unit tests for the session slice actions and selectors using Vitest. Test state transitions for adding, updating, selecting, and forking sessions. Mock persistence if necessary.

tasks.title: Write Unit Test: Session Manager Hook
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/hooks/useSessionManager.spec.ts`. Write unit tests for the `useSessionManager` hook using Vitest and React Testing Library's `renderHook`. Mock Zustand store interactions and test the hook's returned functions.

tasks.title: Create Session Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `lib/session-utils.ts` (if needed). Implement any pure utility functions required for manipulating session data (e.g., generating initial timestamps, formatting names) that can be shared and tested independently.

tasks.title: Write Unit Test: Session Utilities
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/lib/session-utils.spec.ts`. Write unit tests for functions defined in `lib/session-utils.ts` using Vitest, ensuring they produce the correct output for given inputs.

tasks.title: Write Unit Test: Session List Item Component
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/components/SessionListItem.spec.tsx`. Write unit tests for the `SessionListItem` component using Vitest and React Testing Library. Verify correct rendering based on props and test click handler invocation.

tasks.title: Write Unit Test: Prompt Input Area Component
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/unit/components/PromptInputArea.spec.tsx`. Write unit tests for `PromptInputArea` using Vitest and RTL. Test textarea state changes, selector interactions, and submit button behavior. Mock API calls and store interactions.

tasks.title: Write Integration Test: Improve API
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/integration/api/improve.integration.spec.ts`. Write integration tests for the `/api/improve` endpoint using Vitest/Supertest or similar. Mock external LLM calls. Test validation, locking logic, and successful response structure.

tasks.title: Write Integration Test: Name Session API
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/integration/api/name-session.integration.spec.ts`. Write integration tests for the `/api/name-session` endpoint. Mock external LLM calls. Test validation and successful response structure.

tasks.title: Write E2E Test: Session Management
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/e2e/session.spec.ts`. Write Playwright E2E tests covering session management: creating a new session, switching between sessions, verifying state persistence (via UI), and forking a session.

tasks.title: Write E2E Test: Improvement Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create `tests/e2e/improvement.spec.ts`. Write Playwright E2E tests for the core prompt improvement workflow: configuring LLMs, submitting a prompt, verifying history update, checking config locking, and performing subsequent improvements.

tasks.title: Create Preview Deployment Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create `.github/workflows/deploy-preview.yml`. Configure a GitHub Actions workflow to deploy feature branches to a preview environment (e.g., Vercel Preview Deployments). Include build steps and deployment commands.

tasks.title: Create Production Deployment Workflow
tasks.prompt: Create `.github/workflows/deploy-prod.yml`. Configure a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on merges to `main` or tags. Include build steps and commands to deploy to the production environment (e.g., `vercel deploy --prod`).

tasks.prompt: Update `README.md`. Ensure it accurately reflects the final project state, including features, updated setup instructions, and potentially a link to the live application or further documentation.

tasks.prompt: Update `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Fill in the details for each section based on the final implementation, decisions made, and technologies used. Ensure diagrams or descriptions are accurate.

tasks.prompt: Update `docs/API_GUIDE.md`. Detail the final request/response schemas, authentication (if any), and usage examples for each API endpoint based on the implemented backend routes.
